_note: Native Wave 2 profile lane (/me/profile, /profile/me/privacy). The port is proven offline (jest-expo + RNTL, no network; the native app has no production profile — assertNotProduction() refuses prod/staging hosts). Every write (identity / about / account sheet saves, visibility tier cycles) is asserted as the BUILT request on an in-memory client double and never sent (requirements R5.2). Every command runs with APP_PROFILE=development. Device-runtime parity (Maestro + iOS simulator / Android emulator screenshots + parity vs the 390x844 read-only staging web screen) is DEFERRED to G1 as next_actor: owner (requirements R5.3, tasks 6); for this write-heavy cluster it runs only on the isolated G1 environment, never against a live backend as the test account. Recorded here, not run in CI, not a merge blocker.
